name: Elwynn: a ghost released in Fargodeep Mine reaches the Goldshire Spirit Healer (#7648)
contract: A player who dies inside Fargodeep Mine (zone 10124 or 10125, at the Kobold Miner spawn (-9823.76,122.362,4.11124)) releases at the nearest graveyard linked to the mine, as zone 12 links it: Goldshire 106 (-9339.46,171.408,61.5618), about 490 yards, ahead of Northshire 105, instead of the default Westfall graveyard. Its Spirit Healer 6491 stands near it. Death and spirit release use the native handlers.

steps.label: The released player is a ghost
The ghost lands at the Goldshire graveyard
A Spirit Healer stands at the ghost's graveyard
